records.translation_ar: خلل أداء مؤقت توقف المحرك داخل وحدة التحكم ECM/PCM

causes.evidence: Requires factory repair manual if calibration already current

diagnostic_steps: Read P2610 and Freeze Frame with Techstream
Verify vehicle, ECM calibration ID and modification label against year-specific TSB
If existing calibration is latest, bulletin does not apply; follow matched Lexus Repair Manual
Only for bulletin-eligible calibration, perform authorized ECM flash with stable 13.5 V power supply
Road test and recheck DTC; never automatically replace ECM

live_data.normal_spec: See model-specific calibration table; no generic range

parts.name: ECM/PCM
parts.action: reprogram only per TSB; do not replace ECM

records.translation_ar: كفاءة نظام المحول الحفاز أقل من الحد المطلوب — بنك الأسطوانات 2

causes.item: Downstream oxygen sensor B2S2 signal/impedance abnormal
causes.evidence: Conditional OEM TSB threshold; sensor replacement only if criterion satisfied

causes.item: Catalyst efficiency/exhaust/combustion or sensor wiring fault
causes.evidence: Requires matched repair-manual diagnosis when TSB threshold not met; not isolated by code alone

diagnostic_steps: With Techstream confirm P0430 and scan accompanying DTC
With engine at normal operating temperature, inspect O2 B2S2 Voltage and O2 Impedance B2S2
If B2S2 voltage is 1.275 V OR impedance exceeds 300 ohms under TSB conditions, follow bulletin for B2 O2 sensor and harness clamp replacement
If neither criterion is met, bulletin does not apply: follow matched Lexus TIS for catalyst/air-fuel system diagnostics
Clear codes and confirm after drive cycle

live_data.bulletin_trigger: 1.275 V; conditional diagnosis, NOT general normal voltage
>300 ohms; conditional diagnosis, NOT general normal impedance

parts.name: Oxygen Sensor No. 2, Bank 2
parts.location: Factory TIS for 2010 RX450h 2GR-FXE required for verified installation position
parts.replacement_criterion: Only when TSB criteria are met

parts.name: Wire harness clamp
parts.replacement_criterion: Per TSB when sensor replacement is indicated

records.definition_en: Pressure Control Solenoid 'A' Actuator Stuck Off
records.translation_ar: تعطل تشغيل مشغل صمام التحكم بالضغط A وبقاؤه في وضع الإيقاف
symptoms: Harsh engagement when shifting into Drive

causes.evidence: Lexus L-SB-0005-19 Rev1; verify VIN and calibration
Not excluded by bulletin; factory repair manual required if updated or not eligible

diagnostic_steps: Confirm P07457F with Techstream; capture freeze-frame and ECM calibration ID
Verify RX350 MY2019 8AT production plant, trim, drivetrain and VIN relative to TSB production-change thresholds
If covered and calibration is old, follow authorized ECM flash procedure with stabilized power
ECM replacement is explicitly NOT part of bulletin repair
If vehicle outside TSB or calibration current, diagnose solenoid/hydraulic/wiring using vehicle-specific Lexus TIS
Clear DTC and verify Drive engagement after road test

live_data.requirement: Check against bulletin and precise VIN

parts.name: ECM/PCM software
parts.action: reprogram if eligible; do NOT replace ECM

applicability.vin_condition: Only vehicles built before production change effective VINs in Rev1; select plant/trim/drivetrain first

notes: RX350L is listed within production-change table but formal applicability table specifies RX350 only; RX350L mapping deferred

market_warning: USA bulletin applicability is not European/Swedish applicability
